properties.name: The memory measurement counts the cost of giving content structure apart from the benefit of using it
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "Go with your recommendation is (b), (c) and (d) next, and (a)" (option d)
properties.statement: The measurement reports the two passes separately: what it costs to give the content structure (the writing rounds) and what using it returns (the answering round, and each later read). A structure that pays off only when it is read many times shows as such, rather than as one blended cost.
